environment_shift.description: Downstream gateway queue congestion causes immediate retries to fail, while delayed retries remain highly effective.

learning_statement: In context TIMEOUT_TRANSIENT+MID, environment shifted P(IMMEDIATE_RETRY) from 0.80 to 0.12. Strategy engine observed outcomes, driving posterior mean from 0.79 down to 0.59. Optimal policy adapted from IMMEDIATE_RETRY to DELAYED_RETRY.
